title: When the Regiment Wakes
author: Xanthe Reyes
blurb: Bram Okafor, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent three years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
